data.body: Milestone update. Gerrit 2195 merged after LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and zero unresolved comments. Gerrit 2197, 2198, and 2199 remain open with LLM-Review +1 and their last observed Verified results pending. F21 is amended locally at 13ebc0df6ec227c0f7d73804e3433dba48c2e925 with the no-fallback correction and a green held-out oracle. F24 remains deferred. Its post-import byte and Git reference integrity check belongs to rebar fsck under the present command contracts. rebar doctor does not compose fsck and instead diagnoses repairable tracker, link, lock, and mapping conditions. Moving the check to doctor now would omit fsck coverage.
